title: paeonia feminea var. humilis
intro: Paeonia feminea var. humilis, commonly known as the dwarf peony, is a variety of the peony plant that is native to Asia and is highly valued for its medicinal properties. This plant is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and pain, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia feminea var. humilis include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and lower fever, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Paeonia feminea var. humilis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
